title: 2 spacecraft in orbit and 8 more coming soon: Varda has big plans for in-space manufacturing
caption:
Could the future of manufacturing be in orbit? Varda Space Industries is testing autonomous mini-factories designed to produce goods in microgravity and return them safely to Earth. With more missions launching soon, they're aiming to turn space-based production into a regular, repeatable process.
